commit.message:
KAFKA-20925: Use request header v3 for the share group state RPCs (#23821)

Jira: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20925

KIP-1313:

https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/KAFKA/pages/406624038/KIP-1313+Client+instance+ID+in+all+request+headers

This PR adds metadata version 4.5-IV0 and new versions of the share
group state RPCs that use the v3 request header: ReadShareGroupState v1,
WriteShareGroupState v2, InitializeShareGroupState v1,
DeleteShareGroupState v1 and ReadShareGroupStateSummary v2. The share
group state persister sends the new versions only when the metadata
version is 4.5-IV0 or later, so brokers keep using the v2 request header
until every broker in the cluster supports v3. Like the other v3 request
header versions, the new versions are marked unstable.

MINOR: Test topic removal in the share group assignor (#23874)

This adds explicit tests for assignments containing a topic that a
member   no longer subscribes to, covering both homogeneous and
heterogeneous   subscriptions.

- testAssignWithUnsubscribedTopicHomogeneous: two members each hold one
   partition of topic 1 and one partition of topic 2, after the group's
   subscription changes to topic 1 only. It verifies that topic 2 is
   revoked by
SimpleHomogeneousAssignmentBuilder#revokeUnassignablePartitions.

- testAssignWithUnsubscribedTopicHeterogeneous: member A drops topic 2
   while member B still subscribes to it. It verifies that A's partition
   of topic 2 is revoked and that B ends up with both partitions of
topic 2.

Topic 1 has four partitions, with only two initially assigned. Both
tests  verify that each member retains its existing partition of topic 1
and  receives one of the remaining partitions.

KAFKA-18574 Sort test tables in JUnit summary by class and test name (#23945)

The test tables in the JUnit job summary (Failed, Flaky, Skipped,
Quarantined and New) are printed in the order the reports are parsed,
which follows the filesystem order of `glob()` and is not stable across
environments. This sorts each table by class name and test name before
rendering.

This is a continuation of #21786, which was closed as stale.

MINOR: suppress unchecked warning in WorkerTest (#23893)

Mocking `Transformation.class` with Mockito returns a raw type, causing
an unchecked conversion to `Transformation<SourceRecord>`.

```
> Task :connect:runtime:compileTestJava
Note:
/Users/parker/opensource/kafka/connect/runtime/src/test/java/org/apache/kafka/connect/runtime/WorkerTest.java
uses unchecked or unsafe operations.
Note: Recompile with -Xlint:unchecked for details.
```

Add a local `@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")`, following the existing
approach in `TransformationStageTest.applyAndAssert`.

Validation:
- `./gradlew :connect:runtime:compileTestJava --rerun-tasks`
- The unchecked message for WorkerTest.java no longer appeared.

 <[email removed]>

MINOR: Propagate ClusterInstance#createTopic errors and clean up callers (#23699)

ClusterInstance#createTopic and #createTopicWithAssignment did not wait
for the CreateTopics result, so a failed creation was hidden behind the
60s waitTopicCreation timeout, or ignored if the topic already existed.
They now call get() and wrap the cause in a RuntimeException.
InterruptedException is rethrown as InterruptException, so callers no
longer need to declare checked exceptions.

Also removes the now redundant throws clauses, assertDoesNotThrow
wrappers and pass-through helpers, and a duplicate createTopic call in
PlaintextConsumerTest#testSeek.

Follow-up to #23513.

 <[email removed]>

KAFKA-21353 The incorrect parameter in internal-api-checker.md breaks the site build (#23948)

The Hugo site build fails because docs/apis/internal-api-checker.md uses
`{{< param fullDotVersion >}}`, and `fullDotVersion` is not a defined
site param.

This PR replaces it with the hardcoded version `4.4.0`, matching how
other docs
pages (e.g. apis/_index.md, quickstart.md, docker.md) refer to the
release version.
